description: Defines the RpcState class and related structures for managing RPC sessions, binders, and communication in Android's binder IPC framework.

classes.name: RpcState
classes.description: Manages RPC session state, binder references, and communication.

classes.name: RpcState::BinderNode
classes.description: Represents a binder node, either local or remote, with associated transaction and reference info.

methods.name: readNewSessionResponse
methods.description: Reads response for a new RPC session.

methods.name: getRootObject
methods.description: Retrieves the root binder object for a session.

methods.name: getMaxThreads
methods.description: Gets maximum thread count for a session.

methods.name: transact
methods.description: Performs a transaction with a binder object.

methods.name: transactAddress
methods.description: Performs a transaction using an address.

methods.name: sendDecStrongToTarget
methods.description: Sends a decrement strong ref count to a target binder.

methods.name: getAndExecuteCommand
methods.description: Retrieves and executes a command from the session.

methods.name: sendObituaries
methods.description: Sends obituaries for remote binders on shutdown.

methods.name: countBinders
methods.description: Counts binders known in the session.
